units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:9">Shebi. III, 9</cite> <he>אבני כ׳ באין וכ׳</he> heavy stones may be taken in the Sabbatical year from any place (their size showing their designation for building purposes); <he>כל שהן נטלות … על הכ׳</he> those which are carried, two or three at a time, on the shoulder.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 68b:12">B. Mets. 68ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 5:6">Tosef. ib. V, 6</cite> <he>מקום שנהגו להעלות שכר כ׳ למעות</he> where it is customary to add a remuneration for carriage to the money (to be paid to the partner on settling).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 22:6">Gen. XXII, 6</cite>) <he>כזה שהוא טוען … על כְּתֵפוֹ</he> like him (the culprit) who carries his cross on his shoulders; a. fr.

senses.gloss: grapes on an arm of a vine which branches off into twigs, contrad. to נטף grapes hanging down from the trunk.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 7:4">Peah VII, 4</cite> what is gleaning (belonging to the poor, <cite ref="Leviticus 19:10">Lev. XIX, 10</cite>)? <he>כל שאין לה כ׳ וכ׳</he> the grapes remaining on a stalk which has no arm (its grapes having been collected) &c.; expl. Tosef. ib. III, 11; Y. ib. VII, 20ᵃ bot., v. <cite ref="Q01274"><he>פְּסִיגָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>כְּתֵפִים</he>, <he>כְּתֵיפִים</he>, constr. <he>כִּתְפוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite> <he>נאה להרכיבה על כ׳</he> it is proper to carry her on (human) shoulders; a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 161:6">Yalk. Gen. 161</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:10">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="K01066"><he>כְּפָתָה</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:4">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01018"><he>כָּפִיס</he></cite>.]
